tests.name: Long string that works
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(1390)
words = [''.join(random.choices('abc', k=random.randint(1, 6))) for _ in range(300)]
s = ''.join(random.choice(words) for _ in range(80))[:300]
while not s:
    s = random.choice(words)
